The '''Great Revolt''' was an event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]] which resulted in death of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Lorac]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Denira]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]] executed a coup d'état on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. The move was in response to the discovery that King Lorac, ruler of the world, was a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Imperials worked in tandem with [[Regent/Legends|Lord Regent]] [[Zelor]] and paid a crowd to attack the king, Queen Denira and the rest of the royal family, save [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Anod]], who was an Imperial sympathizer.<ref name="wotc" />

Nevertheless, Crown Prince [[Denid]] and his betrothed, [[Loren (noble)|Loren]] escaped to the planet [[Tantajoc V]] with the help of their [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]] servant, [[Jedidiah]]. Due to Velmorian law, twenty years had to pass before Denid could be declared [[Death/Legends|dead]] and Anod crowned king. The moment arrived in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. However a pair of offworlders, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], visited the planet with the lost Crown Prince and ensured he was restored to the throne.<ref name="marvel49" />
